parsed.summary: Failures need a row-level signal; the band needs more separation.

issues.problem: A failing suite only shows as one red cell among 31; nothing in the row says it failed.
issues.why: Finding today's failing suites means scanning 217 cells.
issues.fix: Add a failure count after the suite label, e.g. 'billing - 1 failed', in --danger #B42318.
issues.evidence: Rows billing, deploy, webhooks and audit each have one red cell and no other signal.

issues.problem: The band #F7F8FB is nearly invisible against the white page, so the note floats loose under the header.
issues.why: The note explains retries; it should read as part of the header, not stray text.
issues.fix: --band #F7F8FB -> #E0E3EC. The note text #5E677B still passes AA on it at 4.9:1.
issues.evidence: Computed 4.9:1 for --text-note #5E677B on #E0E3EC, above the 4.5:1 AA bar.

answers.question: Can someone find today's failing suites in five seconds?
answers.answer: Not quite: the four red cells are findable but small.

answers.question: Does the note band read as part of the page header?
answers.answer: Barely; the band is too close to white.
